name: sentiment_analysis_nusax_benchmark
description: A sentiment classification benchmark hosted on Hugging Face (NUSAX) for assessing sentiment analysis models on Nusantara/local language data. Measures models' ability to predict sentiment labels for short texts/comments drawn from regional sources.
evaluation_method: F1 (typically macro-F1) or accuracy for classification
reputation: A small community dataset focused on Nusantara languages; primarily used by researchers working on regional language NLP with limited broader adoption.
